cases.rationale: Freeze an exact commanded speed near the stated absolute 80 mph number; measure original maximum without assigning a legal verdict.
unresolved_judgment_calls: actual achievable speed and transient response

channels.name: kin.speed
channels.method: original actor velocity norm each recorded tick
channels.uncertainty: 20 Hz source sample and CARLA velocity telemetry

channels.uncertainty: 20 Hz source sample and CARLA transform telemetry

channels.name: ru.subject
channels.method: original actor ID, blueprint, and subject role at each recorded tick
channels.uncertainty: synthetic subject attribution must be checked at live capture

limitations: Synthetic public vehicular access is an authored setup assumption.
Diagnostic fixtures are incomplete motion and cannot prove an 80 mph crossing.
